import sys

def main():
    read = sys.stdin
    n = int(read.readline())
    line = read.readline().strip()
    
    countInParens = 0
    maxLenOutside = 0
    
    tokens = line.split("(")
    for token in tokens:
        if ")" in token:
            parts = token.split(")", 1)
            inside = parts[0]
            words = inside.split("_")
            for w in words:
                if w.strip():
                    countInParens += 1
            if len(parts) > 1:
                outside = parts[1]
                outsideWords = outside.split("_")
                for w in outsideWords:
                    if w:
                        maxLenOutside = max(maxLenOutside, len(w))
        else:
            outsideWords = token.split("_")
            for w in outsideWords:
                if w:
                    maxLenOutside = max(maxLenOutside, len(w))
    
    print(f"{maxLenOutside} {countInParens}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
